tagline: Chinese open-source Minecraft resource portal built as a fork of Modrinth
description: BBSMC (bbsmc.net) is a popular open-source Minecraft resource portal and community (fork of Modrinth) featuring mods, modpacks, maps, shaders, resource packs, server plugins, and client tools.
features: Open-source fork of Modrinth (code on GitHub)
Directory of Minecraft mods, modpacks, and clients
Shaders, texture packs, maps, and server plugins
Active community of players and creators
